# Bagaicha Flower Decor and Events

## Alternate names
Bagaicha Flower Decor, Bagaicha Flower Decor & Events, Bagaicha Decor

## Description
Bagaicha Flower Decor and Events provides flower decor and event styling for celebrations in Pokhara. Services include weddings, family rituals and intimate or corporate events.

## Address
Newroad-8, Pokhara, Gandaki Pradesh, Nepal

## Opening hours
Sunday–Saturday · 7:00 AM–7:00 PM

## Services
- Wedding Decoration
- Wedding Reception
- Pasni (Annaprashan)
- Bratabandha
- Haldi & Mehendi
- Birthday Decoration
- Car Decoration
- Anniversary & Engagement
- Baby Shower & Welcome
- Corporate & Other Events
